# Inventory  
[⌂ HOME](/d/dpp-home) · [SALES](/d/dpp-sales) · CATALOG · ADS · **INVENTORY** · FINANCE · TRAJECTORY · [DATA HEALTH](/d/dpp-data-health)  
*Days cover uses trailing-28-day unit velocity. Treat new/no-sales SKUs separately.*

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(fulfillable_quantity),0)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT COALESCE(sum(inbound_working_quantity+inbound_shipped_quantity+inbound_receiving_quantity),0)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';

WITH v AS (SELECT seller_sku,sum(units)::numeric/28 units_day FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku) SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current i JOIN v USING(seller_sku) WHERE i.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND i.fulfillable_quantity=0 AND v.units_day>0;

WITH v AS (SELECT seller_sku,sum(units)::numeric/28 units_day FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku) SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current i JOIN v USING(seller_sku) WHERE i.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND v.units_day>0 AND i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<14;
SELECT COALESCE(sum(unfulfillable_quantity),0)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT extract(epoch from (now()-max(snapshot_at)))/60 AS value FROM core.inventory_snapshot WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';

WITH v AS (SELECT seller_sku,sum(units)::numeric/28 units_day,sum(units) units_t28,sum(sales) sales_t28 FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku) SELECT i.seller_sku AS "SKU", COALESCE(k.title,'') AS "Product", i.asin AS "ASIN", i.fulfillable_quantity AS "Available", i.reserved_quantity AS "Reserved", (i.inbound_working_quantity+i.inbound_shipped_quantity+i.inbound_receiving_quantity) AS "Inbound", COALESCE(v.units_t28,0) AS "Units T28", round(COALESCE(v.sales_t28,0),0) AS "Sales T28", CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 THEN round(i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day,1) END AS "Days Cover", CASE WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity=0 AND COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 THEN 'STOCKOUT' WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)=0 THEN 'HOLD' WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<14 THEN 'PRODUCE' WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<28 THEN 'PLAN' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Action" FROM mart.inventory_current i LEFT JOIN v USING(seller_sku) LEFT JOIN core.sku k ON k.sku=i.seller_sku WHERE i.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity=0 AND COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 AND i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<14 THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 AND i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<28 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)=0 THEN 4 ELSE 3 END, "Days Cover" NULLS LAST;
SELECT snapshot_at AS time,sum(fulfillable_quantity) AS value,'Available' AS metric FROM core.inventory_snapshot WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' GROUP BY snapshot_at ORDER BY snapshot_at;

SELECT snapshot_at AS time,sum(inbound_working_quantity+inbound_shipped_quantity+inbound_receiving_quantity) AS value,'Inbound' AS metric FROM core.inventory_snapshot WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' GROUP BY snapshot_at ORDER BY snapshot_at;

SELECT seller_sku AS "SKU", unfulfillable_quantity AS "Unfulfillable", researching_quantity AS "Researching", reserved_quantity AS "Reserved" FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND (unfulfillable_quantity>0 OR researching_quantity>0) ORDER BY unfulfillable_quantity DESC,researching_quantity DESC;
